race.comment: BELCONY (10) is a strong chance after consecutive BM66 thirds on soft tracks, beaten just over half a length at Sale last start and just over a length at Geelong before that. She is proven at the distance and Jake Noonan has a sound record on her, drawn for every hope. TILL QUEEN (2) resumes off two trials and has a strong overall record, with her Bendigo BM62 win two runs ago supported by a solid fifth in F BM70 company at the Heath. Should take beating. BIT OF SHOOSH (1) resumes after a consistent last campaign and maps well midfield. He may want a touch further but should be sharp enough to figure. BLACK ACES (6) is lightly raced off a maiden win at Warrnambool, scoring by two lengths. Can go on with it now.
